platformLimits.manifestAndModelStep: Raycast preferences are a static JSON manifest, so the aiProvider dropdown can only list the curated built-ins; models.dev is fetched at runtime and therefore cannot be declared there. The catalogue provider + model picker is the 'choose-ai-provider' List command (provider list → pushed model List), and its pick is stored as a LocalStorage override. The model step is navigation.push inside that command, not a second manifest command.
platformLimits.note: Declared as a platform limit: manifest dropdown = curated built-ins, List command = full catalogue + models.
